name: Time-Sensitive QA Dataset
description: A dataset constructed to benchmark and diagnose QA models' temporal reasoning capabilities by focusing on time-sensitive questions derived from time-evolving facts mined from WikiData and verified by crowd workers. It challenges models on temporal understanding and reasoning.
reputation: A specialized temporal QA benchmark that is cited for probing time-sensitive reasoning, but it is not yet a broadly standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Highlights the lack of temporal reasoning ability in current QA models; best model achieves 46% accuracy vs. human 87%.
